authority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1, sections 2.13 and 9
authority.requirement: Handle code 3 is hard ownership, 4 is soft pointer, and 5 is hard pointer. HEADER table-control references are hard owners; BLOCK_RECORD, standard LTYPE and plot-settings dictionary references are hard pointers.

physicalProducer.producer: ODA File Converter 27.1.0, locally authored one-LINE DXF converted to AC1021
physicalProducer.observation: LibreDWG 0.14 independently reports code 3 for all nine non-null table-control links and code 5 for both space BLOCK_RECORD links and the BYLAYER, BYBLOCK and CONTINUOUS LTYPE links.

finding: The HEADER writer used handle code 4, a soft pointer, for all of those non-null references, calling it a hard pointer in a misleading helper comment.
change: Use code 3 for table-control references and code 5 for non-null hard pointers. The historical null representation and unresolved current-style/layer references are intentionally unchanged in this slice.

validation.coverage: An all-six-version generated HEADER checks actual emitted bitstream handle tokens: nine table controls (ten in AC1015) have hard-owner code 3; model/paper BLOCK_RECORD and three standard LTYPE links have hard-pointer code 5. The owning complete-DWG roundtrip and R2007 physical metadata/section-map tests also pass.
validation.independentRead: LibreDWG 0.14 reports the same reference roles for the scratch generated AC1021 as for the ODA-generated positive control.

independentConverter.input: Scratch minimal one-LINE AC1021 with corrected non-null HEADER roles and experimental current layer/style/linetype/dimstyle references bound to the generated defaults
independentConverter.operation: ACAD2013 DXF, recursion disabled, audit disabled
independentConverter.result: Exit status zero with only an .err reporting Invalid input; no DXF was produced.
independentConverter.interpretation: Correcting these roles and that experimental default-only binding does not resolve ODA rejection. The experimental binding ignores caller-selected names and was not committed.

limits: Caller-selected current HEADER references and typed null-reference roles remain open.
No support claim or external semantic qualification follows from this slice.
